logger.doc:name: Start MySQL query
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Sys-Solutech] GET /" ++ ((vars.endpoint default "") as String) ++ " started. database=" ++ ((attributes.queryParams.database default "") as String) ++ " pageNumber=" ++ ((attributes.queryParams.pageNumber default "") as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- p("db.limit") as Number default 10000
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- attributes.queryParams.pageNumber as Number default 0

%dw 2.0 output application/java var pageNumber = attributes.queryParams.pageNumber as Number default 0 var pageSize = p("db.limit") as Number default 10000 --- (if (pageNumber < 0) 0 else pageNumber) * pageSize
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (attributes.queryParams.fromDate != null) (attributes.queryParams.fromDate as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}) else ""
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (attributes.queryParams.toDate != null) (attributes.queryParams.toDate as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}) else ""

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = vars.supplier as String default "" var fromTs = (vars.fromDate as String default "") ++ " 00:00:00" var toTs = (vars.toDate as String default "") ++ " 00:00:00" --- "Select a.*, b.routeid from " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("db.table.sales") ++ " as a left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("db.table.visits") ++ " as b on a.VisitID = b.visitid inner join " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("db.table.products") ++ " as c on a.PRODUCT_ID = c.id and c.supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "' where a.Created_AT between '" ++ fromTs ++ "' and '" ++ toTs ++ "' order by a.Entry_ID desc LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String)

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var supplier = (vars.supplier default "") as String --- "SELECT * FROM " ++ db ++ "." ++ p("db.table.products") ++ " WHERE supplier = '" ++ supplier ++ "' ORDER BY id LIMIT " ++ (((vars.limit as Number) + 1) as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.offset as String)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var rows = payload default [] var limitNum = vars.limit as Number default 10000 var hasMore = (sizeOf(rows) default 0) > limitNum --- if (hasMore and limitNum > 0) rows[0 to (limitNum - 1)] else rows

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var rows = payload default [] var limitNum = vars.limit as Number default 10000 --- (sizeOf(rows) default 0) > limitNum

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var data = payload default [] var pageNumber = vars.pageNumber as Number default 0 var path = (attributes.requestPath default ("/api/" ++ (vars.endpoint default ""))) as String var fromDate = vars.fromDate as String default "" var toDate = vars.toDate as String default "" var qs = "?" ++ (if (fromDate != "") ("fromDate=" ++ fromDate ++ "&") else "") ++ (if (toDate != "") ("toDate=" ++ toDate ++ "&") else "") ++ "pageNumber=" ++ ((pageNumber + 1) as String) var nextUrl = path ++ qs --- { data: data } ++ (if (vars.hasMore default false) { next: nextUrl } else {})
